components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main action on a page or in a drawer footer, such as Record sale or Save.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-primary"><svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M5 12h14"/><path d="M12 5v14"/></svg>Record sale</button>
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; height:44px; padding:0 16px; border:1px solid transparent; border-radius:0.5rem; background:oklch(0.81 0.11 294.7); color:oklch(0.12 0.02 295.7); font-family: 'Inter Variable', Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size:14px; font-weight:500; cursor:pointer; transition:background .15s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background:color-mix(in oklch, oklch(0.81 0.11 294.7) 80%, transparent); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, oklch(0.81 0.11 294.7) 50%, transparent); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform:translateY(1px); }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Secondary header action, such as Stock input, and Cancel in drawers.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { height:44px; padding:0 16px; border:1px solid oklch(0.280 0.030 295.9); border-radius:0.5rem; background:color-mix(in oklch, oklch(0.280 0.030 295.9) 30%, oklch(0.152 0.017 295.7)); color:oklch(0.971 0.009 299.2); font-family: 'Inter Variable', Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size:14px; font-weight:500; cursor:pointer; transition:background .15s; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background:oklch(0.246 0.027 297.5); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, oklch(0.81 0.11 294.7) 50%, transparent); }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Label above, unit inside, note below.
components.css: .ds-field { display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:8px; width:260px; font-family: 'Inter Variable', Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-field-label { font-size:14px; font-weight:500; color:oklch(0.971 0.009 299.2); } .ds-field-wrap { position:relative; } .ds-input { box-sizing:border-box; width:100%; height:44px; padding:4px 48px 4px 10px; border:1px solid oklch(0.280 0.030 295.9); border-radius:0.5rem; background:color-mix(in oklch, oklch(0.280 0.030 295.9) 30%, oklch(0.152 0.017 295.7)); color:oklch(0.971 0.009 299.2); font-size:14px; outline:none; transition:border-color .15s; } .ds-input:focus-visible { border-color:oklch(0.81 0.11 294.7); outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, oklch(0.81 0.11 294.7) 50%, transparent); } .ds-field-unit { position:absolute; right:12px; top:50%; transform:translateY(-50%); font-size:14px; color:oklch(0.80 0.032 302.3); } .ds-field-note { font-size:12px; color:oklch(0.80 0.032 302.3); }

components.name: Stat Card
components.description: Overview snapshot figure on a flat Panel Violet card.
components.html: Sales this month3,600.00 ETB1 sale
components.css: .ds-card { display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:4px; width:260px; padding:16px; border-radius:0.7rem; background:oklch(0.200 0.022 296.9); box-shadow:0 0 0 1px color-mix(in oklch, oklch(0.971 0.009 299.2) 10%, transparent); font-family: 'Inter Variable', Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-card-label { font-size:14px; color:oklch(0.80 0.032 302.3); } .ds-card-value { font-family:'Geist Variable', Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size:30px; font-weight:600; letter-spacing:-0.025em; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; color:oklch(0.971 0.009 299.2); } .ds-card-hint { font-size:12px; color:oklch(0.80 0.032 302.3); }

components.html: OverviewInputsProductsSales
components.css: .ds-nav { display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:4px; width:220px; padding:12px; background:oklch(0.170 0.017 296); font-family: 'Inter Variable', Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-nav-item { display:flex; align-items:center; height:44px; padding:0 10px; border-radius:0.4rem; color:oklch(0.971 0.009 299.2); font-size:14px; text-decoration:none; transition:background .15s; } .ds-nav-item:hover { background:oklch(0.246 0.027 297.5); } .ds-nav-item[aria-current=page] { background:oklch(0.246 0.027 297.5); color:oklch(0.81 0.11 294.7); } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, oklch(0.81 0.11 294.7) 50%, transparent); }

components.name: Stock Level Bar
components.description: Signature component: fill by health, low-level marker at midpoint, status icon.
components.css: .ds-stock { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; width:200px; } .ds-stock-track { position:relative; flex:1; height:10px; border-radius:999px; background:oklch(0.246 0.027 297.5); } .ds-stock-fill { position:absolute; inset:0 auto 0 0; width:37%; border-radius:999px; background:oklch(0.90 0.12 85); } .ds-stock-marker { position:absolute; left:50%; top:50%; width:2px; height:14px; transform:translate(-50%,-50%); background:rgb(212 212 212 / .5); box-shadow:0 0 0 1px oklch(0.152 0.017 295.7); } .ds-stock-icon { color:color-mix(in oklch, oklch(0.90 0.12 85) 80%, transparent); }

narrative.overview:
The name is the brief: a plain, honest tool for counting what a business has, makes and sells. Everything is in service of exact numbers read quickly, on a phone on the production floor or on a desktop at the end of the day. The interface is one dark theme, Violet Hour: deep violet-black surfaces, near-white text, and a single soft violet accent that marks what you can act on.

Density is deliberate. Lists are tables with tight rows, right-aligned tabular figures, and a pinned first column, because the job is comparing amounts. Work happens in drawers that slide over the list (from the right on desktop, from the bottom on phones), so the user never loses their place. Surfaces are flat and separated by tone and hairline rings, not shadows.

Components are refined and restrained: thin borders, modest radii, one accent, and no decoration that does not carry meaning. Status is the one place colour speaks loudly, and it always speaks with an icon and words.
keyCharacteristics: One dark theme only; no light mode or theme picker.
One violet accent for primary actions, active navigation, focus and the chart line.
Flat, tonal layering: background → sidebar → card → muted, with hairline rings.
Tabular, right-aligned numbers everywhere amounts appear.
Edit-first drawers over lists; the list stays visible behind.
Touch-sized controls (44 px) that compact to 32 px on a fine pointer at desktop widths.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Lavender Signal is the only accent. It marks what you can act on or where you are; it is never decoration.

rules.name: The Never Colour Alone Rule
rules.body: Every severity colour appears with its icon (octagon for error, triangle for warning, info circle, check circle) and with text.

rules.name: The Tabular Numbers Rule
rules.body: Every amount, price, code count and total uses tabular figures and aligns right in tables.

rules.name: The Label On Top Rule
rules.body: Labels sit above their input, including switches and selects.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces at rest have no shadow. Lift comes from tone; only overlays float.

dos: Do use Lavender Signal (oklch(0.81 0.11 294.7)) only for primary actions, the active nav item, focus and selection.
Do pair every severity colour with its icon and words (octagon error, triangle warning, info, check).
Do right-align amounts with tabular figures and put units inside inputs ("kg", "pcs", "ETB").
Do keep controls 44 px tall on touch and phones; compact to 32 px only on a fine pointer from 768 px.
Do open add and edit work in a drawer over the list, with Save in a pinned footer.
Do put labels above fields and feedback below them.
Do keep one primary table per page, with the name and code pinned in the first column.
donts: Don't add a light theme or a theme picker; Violet Hour is the only theme.
Don't use shadows on resting surfaces; separate them with tone and hairline rings.
Don't show status with colour alone, or put the stock number as visible text beside the stock bar.
Don't add a second accent colour or use the accent for decoration.
Don't use Deep Brick destructive fills outside confirmation steps.
